patch_description: Replace the reactive residual-only consensus velocity update with a bounded velocity-consensus update. The new velocity target blends the Kalman tracker velocity, which carries persistent trend evidence, with the actual consensus-level step. Its per-sample acceleration is clipped relative to robust innovation scale, preventing isolated noise excursions from rapidly flipping the predicted direction. A small velocity deadband further suppresses low-amplitude alternating motion while preserving the predictive level update and low lag during sustained trends.
